literalGroups.primaryGround: The prompt asks the ordinary anatomical attachment made by a tendon. OpenStax 11.1 L30 directly says tendons connect muscles to bones. L47 distinguishes facial muscle insertions in skin; OpenStax 9.1 L30 and L34-L35 describe bone-bone and bone-cartilage joints, giving plausible but different connections.

literalGroups.literal: Сухожилия — прочные полосы плотной упорядоченной соединительной ткани; они передают костям усилие сокращающихся скелетных мышц. Так мышцы приводят кости в движение.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax 11.1 L30 states that skeletal-muscle fiber tension transfers to tendons and that tendons are dense regular connective tissue connecting muscles to bones. The two sentences explain that mechanism and its movement consequence.

literalGroups.literal: Некоторые лицевые скелетные мышцы прикрепляются к коже и двигают её при мимике.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax 11.1 L47 states that origins and insertions of facial muscles are in the skin and that their contraction moves skin for expressions. This is a concrete fact about this distractor.

literalGroups.literal: Сухожилия — прочные полосы плотной упорядоченной соединительной ткани.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax 11.1 L30 describes tendons as strong bands of dense, regular connective tissue. The note adds this composition/structure fact beyond the prompt and keyed relation.

literalGroups.literal: В некоторых суставах соседние кости соединены фиброзной соединительной тканью.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax 9.1 L30 and L34 say adjacent bones can form connections and that fibrous joints unite adjacent bones with fibrous connective tissue. This teaches a different bone-bone connection.

literalGroups.literal: В хрящевом суставе кости соединены гиалиновым или волокнистым хрящом.
literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax 9.1 L30 and L35 describe bone-cartilage connections and cartilaginous joints joined by hyaline cartilage or fibrocartilage. This is a fact about this distractor.
